scope: 15 additional original two-part subsystem and mobility reports. Together with the existing nine reports this covers all 24 damage captions from these two paths. Isolated source proof does not establish live occurrence; playback requires a complete pixel-verified original assignment.

pc_crew_3.style: An experienced American tank crew member speaking over a close dry intercom microphone inside an M1 turret. Firm, clear, clipped, alert under incoming fire. No radio effects or background noise.

pc_gps_damaged.caption: GPS damaged
pc_gps_damaged.direction: An urgent but controlled equipment condition report. Speak exactly the supplied transcript. Pronounce GPS as the letters G P S, and COAX as coax. No added words or vocal noises.
pc_gps_damaged.evidence: godot/tests/fixtures/pc_damage_voice_oracle.json; original isolated instructions, runtime requires complete visible text
